input: Start a monthly book swap with close friends

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The size and location spread of the group determines whether this is an in-person gathering, a mail-based swap, or a hybrid — which changes almost every logistical decision.
Whether the swap is open to any genre or restricted to specific types (fiction, non-fiction, a theme) defines the rules and matching process.
How books are physically exchanged (meetup, post, drop-off) is the most concrete action to plan and directly affects cost and coordination effort.
Whether the swap is paired with a social event (like a book club discussion) or is purely a silent exchange changes the format and time commitment needed.
A budget cap per book affects whether participants buy new, bring used, or only swap what they already own, which shapes the ground rules.
Whether books are randomly assigned, chosen by the recipient, or matched by a host changes the coordination complexity and the experience feel.
Knowing what 'this worked well' looks like — consistent participation, discovering new reads, social bonding — helps prioritise which details to nail down first.

gold.taskTitle: Launch a monthly book swap with close friends
gold.taskDescription: Set up a recurring, informal book exchange among a group of close friends, happening once a month.

questions.title: How many friends are joining the swap?
questions.description: Establish the group size, as this determines matching complexity, communication tools needed, and whether a simple group chat is sufficient to coordinate.

questions.title: Any genre or theme restrictions for the books?
questions.description: Decide whether the swap is open to all books or scoped to a specific genre, theme, or format (e.g. paperback only), which sets the participation rules.

questions.title: Will books be exchanged in person or by post?
questions.description: Determine the physical exchange method, which is the most immediate logistical decision and affects whether in-person meetups need to be scheduled.

questions.title: Is this swap paired with a book discussion meetup?
questions.description: Clarify whether the swap is purely an exchange or also includes a social discussion element, as this changes the event format and time commitment.

questions.title: Is there a price limit per book brought to swap?
questions.description: Set a spending cap or rule (e.g. only books you already own) to keep the exchange fair and accessible for all participants.

questions.title: How should books be matched between participants?
questions.description: Choose the assignment method — random draw, wishlist-based selection, or host-curated matching — as this defines the core swap mechanic and how much coordination is needed.

questions.title: What would make this swap feel like a success?
questions.description: Identify the primary goal — consistent monthly participation, discovering new genres, or strengthening friendships — so the most important details can be prioritised in the setup.
